[SWS_DM_01976] shows an example configuration with event combination in place.
Several
events
are mapped to the same DTC. The combination on storage is repre-
sented by the DTC[1]. The DTC[2] shows an example of the combination on retrieval.
The freeze frame data is stored individually for each
event
.
